purpose: Public-safe signal rows for the Bionic Banker AI Intelligence page. This file describes what the site may show without exposing private infrastructure.
privacy_boundary: No private paths, keys, IPs, client data, employer data, wallet secrets, or internal machine names. Trading-related rows are research and paper-mode context unless a public source explicitly says otherwise.
